rv.q: Funny, inventive, and deeply moving, this fresh adaptation charms with its wit before revealing the emotional depth that has made this story an enduring classic.
As a funny and sentimental rendition of a famous show, Cyrano works by emphasizing sincere pathos.
This new play "Cyrano" offers a fresh and funny version of the original.
Though we really enjoyed the show, and the acting, of course, was great, I found it a little confusing in the beginning.

cn.t: This nimble, contemporary adaptation trades Rostand's speeches for wit and physical comedy, delivering a funny, charming production that effectively tugs at the heartstrings—even without the famous nose.
